sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Guernsey lily is a bulbous geophyte endemic to rocky mountain slopes of the Western Cape, South Africa. It flowers in early autumn and becomes dormant in summer.

sections.title: Leaves and flowers
sections.text: The strap-like leaves appear after flowering and are about 30 cm long and 1–2 cm wide. The nearly leafless flower stalk bears an umbel of scarlet flowers with recurved tepals up to 3.5 cm long.

sections.title: Edibility
sections.text: No food use or species-specific toxicity information was established in the sources consulted.
